justification: A shows a dense, essentially flat field covered with rows of small repeated inscribed signs and mottled pitting, while B shows the back of a monolithic anthropomorphic figure with a head, shoulders and body, bearing a few large discrete motifs (a large ring/disc, arcs and curved bands, paired spirals). The only shared content is generic: shallow relief motifs with curvilinear/circular outlines on stone; there is no correspondence of specific figures, relationships or layout, since one is an ordered textual-looking field and the other is a sculpted human-like body with sparse emblematic devices.
